scope: coding classification and Slack pre-send validation

sourceVerification.method: Fetch each official lesson; require matching data-challenge-category and data-challengeable-type plus an integer data-challenge-level

e2eInitial.failure: 45-second visual test timeout while other checks ran concurrently

validation.build: pass; existing docs chunk-size warning remains

boundaries.unknownSource: excluded from recommendations and rejected before Slack POST
boundaries.databaseCorrection: separate authenticated conditional update; no migration rewrite or seed replay
boundaries.unpostedInvalidPayload: mark FAILED with uncertain=false; never POST to Slack
boundaries.sentHistory: preserved; no retry or correction message requested
